Welcome! I'm starting this blog as a space to share my thoughts on neuroscience, computation, and the intersection of the two.

I'll be writing about topics like computational models of the brain, reinforcement learning, connectomics, and whatever else I find interesting along the way.

Stay tuned for more. In the meantime, feel free to check out my [research and work](../index.html), or reach out via [email](mailto:aaravsinha002@gmail.com).
